story_text:
## Introducing E-Cones by Drilllight
Speed wins games, but decisions win them faster. Meet E-Cones by Drilllight: the world’s first AI-powered illuminated training cones, built to train your brain as hard as your body.
Each cone lights up with unpredictable colors and directions across 53 LEDs. You have to see the signal, scan the field, decide in a split second and react, just like in a real game. Every reaction is timed to the millisecond, and the AI uses your results to build your next session, so your decision-making keeps getting sharper under pressure and fatigue.
Tell the AI coach what you want to train by voice or text, place the cones with AR, and go. Developed over five years with pro clubs and a dedicated team, E-Cones work for sports, fitness and even cognitive rehab.

## Behind the Scenes
risks: Building something that truly changes the way athletes train is never risk-free. But it’s a challenge we believe is worth taking — and one we approach with care, preparation, and honesty. Drilllight was created by people who care deeply about real training, not gadgets. Our responsibility is to deliver a product you can trust, and to be transparent with you every step of the way. Manufacturing & Production: E-Cones are not just an idea on a screen. They are the result of extensive development, testing, and real-world feedback from coaches and athletes. We are working with experienced manufacturing partners who specialize in electronic sports equipment. Production processes have been carefully planned and validated so we can move confidently into larger-scale manufacturing after the campaign. Over the past two years of R&D, we’ve already completed three product iterations and tested them with real athletes in real training conditions. In parallel, we have already put nearly a hundred units into production to validate and stress-test the full manufacturing and assembly pipeline, from components sourcing to quality control and packaging, so we can scale with confidence. That said, hardware projects can face unexpected delays. If this happens, we promise to communicate clearly, quickly, and honestly — always with a plan to move forward. Product Refinement: As we prepare for full production, small refinements may still occur. These improvements are part of making a product stronger, more reliable, and better suited for daily training. Any adjustments will be made with your experience in mind and shared openly with our backers. Quality Control: E-Cones are designed for real athletes, real coaches, and real environments — indoor and outdoor, youth to elite level. Quality matters to us. Each E-Cone will go through multiple quality checks to ensure consistency, durability, and performance before it ships. Logistics & Fulfillment: Shipping products around the world can be unpredictable. Delays caused by customs, transportation, or external factors are always possible. To reduce these risks, we are working with experienced logistics partners and building realistic delivery timelines. Most importantly, we will keep you informed until your reward arrives safely. A Note to Our Backers: Backing a Kickstarter project means joining a journey. We don’t take that lightly. If challenges arise, we won’t hide them. We’ll share updates, explain what’s happening, and work through them with transparency and respect for the community that made Drilllight possible. Thank you for believing in Drilllight — and for helping us bring real, meaningful training to athletes everywhere.

faq.q: What’s the difference between E-Cone Sport and E-Cone Pro?
faq.a: E-Cone Sport is the essential system for individual athletes, youth players, and home or small-club training. It supports up to 8 synced cones. E-Cone Pro adds the full AI suite (AI analysis, AI-generated drills based on your data, AR cone placement) and supports 20+ cones. It’s built for clubs, academies, and serious coaches.

faq.q: Can I see the lights outside in bright sun?
faq.a: Yes. Each E-Cone uses ultra-bright LEDs that stay visible in full daylight, so you can train outdoors at any time of day.

faq.q: How do I know where to put the cones?
faq.a: Point your phone at the field. Drilllight’s augmented reality shows you exactly where each cone goes, so your spacing and angles are right every time, with no measuring tape needed.

faq.q: Does it work with my Garmin, Polar, or Suunto watch?
faq.a: Yes. Drilllight syncs with leading fitness devices like Garmin, Suunto, and Polar, so you can add heart rate, training load, and recovery data to your sessions.

Your reaction time, speed, accuracy, errors, and improvement over time. You can ask the app questions in plain language, like “What’s improving?” or “What should I work on next?”, and get answers without digging through charts.

faq.q: Is it good for kids and young athletes?
faq.a: Yes. E-Cone Sport is designed for all levels, including youth training. The unpredictable light patterns make drills feel like a game, which keeps young athletes engaged.

No. Core training modes, drills, and tracking are included with your purchase. An optional Premium subscription will be available for advanced coaching content, but your E-Cones will always work without it.

faq.q: How do I control the cones?
faq.a: Everything runs through the free Drilllight app for iOS and Android. From there you can pick drills, set colors, timing, and difficulty, and track your performance in real time.

faq.q: Can multiple athletes train at once?
faq.a: Yes. Multi-player and Team Mode let several athletes train, compete, and run relays on the same set of cones.
All of them: soccer, football, basketball, baseball, hockey, tennis, rugby, volleyball, fitness, agility work, and even injury rehab.
Yes. E-Cones are made with impact-resistant materials and built for indoor and outdoor use, on fields, courts, rinks, and in gyms.

faq.q: What makes Drilllight different from other training lights?
faq.a: Most light pods just ask you to tap them. Drilllight adds multi-color LEDs, light panels you can control one side at a time, randomized drills, and a full AI training system. The result is real, movement-based game situations, not just reaction tapping.

faq.q: Are you shipping worldwide and how much is shipping?
faq.a: Yes. We are shipping worldwide and bringing Drilllight to everyone, everywhere. Shipping costs, taxes, and duties may apply to various countries and territories. We're working with our distribution partner to get competitive rates, share estimates as soon as possible and will charge for shipping after the campaign ends.
